title: Trevor Paglen's book on black-project patches
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Trevor Paglen's book on black-project patches, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it basically what it is is a compilation of black project patches

plain: A former Pentagon official turned whistleblower, Matthew Brown, mentions to podcast host Jesse Michels a book by Trevor Paglen. Brown says it is basically a collection of patches, the sewn emblems worn by teams on 'black projects', which are secret US military programmes. It matters because such patches can be one of the few public traces of hidden work.
